summary: Xencor Inc. filed an 8-K on July 29, 2026, reporting a settlement agreement with Alexion Pharma resolving a commercial dispute over U.S. royalties on Ultomiris. Xencor will receive $105 million in two equal payments, the first in August 2026 and the second within 14 days after the one-year anniversary. Alexion will have no further U.S. royalty obligations; ex-U.S. royalties continue. This is a legal settlement, not a special-situation corporate event like a merger, tender, or restructuring. The filing also provides a cash runway update through 2028. The settlement resolves previously disclosed royalty claims, with no structural or transactional elements. What to watch: collection of the second payment and impacts on future royalty revenue.
